transcript:
Meeting header:
2026-03-04 10:30am PT | Duration: 45m
Attendees: Maya Chen (Redwood AE), Ethan Brooks (Redwood SE), Sara Lopez (Bridgepoint Partnerships), Tom Grady (Bridgepoint Sales), Amir Patel (Bridgepoint Solutions)

Summary: quick pipeline review, surface technical reqs for demos, agree who owns outreach to joint accounts, decide on one or two pilot customers for a co-sell push in Q2.

00:00 - Maya Chen: hey everyone, thanks for joining, uh this is Maya from Redwood, i'll kick us off. we have about 45 minutes, main goal to run through the top joint opps that Bridgepoint is working and see what we need from a tech or sales side to push to POC or close.
00:12 - Sara Lopez: thanks Maya, appreciate it. on our side we've flagged three deals we think are a good fit for co-sell. Tom will walk through the customer context.
00:20 - Tom Grady: yeah hi all, uh first one is 'OmniRetail' - they're a mid-market retail chain, they've been asking for personalized search and fast embeddings for product discovery. Bridgepoint has an in with their head of infra. They're doing on-prem infra and really strict data residency. timeline looks like Q2 pilot.
00:38 - Ethan Brooks: quick q - OmniRetail, do they require air-gapped/on-prem exclusively or is hybrid ok? when you say on-prem infra, is that like a VPC with private endpoints or full air gap?
00:49 - Tom Grady: it's mostly VPC right now, but their security team is leaning on on-prem options too. we think they'd accept a private deployment with customer-managed networking.
00:58 - Maya Chen: perfect - that's one of our core plays for private deployments. Redwood Private supports VPC and on-prem packages; we also integrate KMS/HSM for key management. we'll need to confirm audit log retention with their compliance team though.
01:12 - Amir Patel: on that point, can you send over the SOC 2 type 2 cert and any ISO docs? our security folks always ask for those and a short tech checklist.
01:20 - Maya Chen: yes, i'll include SOC2 and the security brief. Ethan, maybe you can pull the quick tech checklist for VPC and KMS required ports, etc.
01:27 - Ethan Brooks: yep i'll put together a 1-pager. note though, for demos we usually provide a dedicated demo stack unless they want a full on-prem install. for the POC we can spin up a dedicated pool on dedicated GPUs, or do a hosted but private networked deploy - there's a cost tradeoff.
01:42 - Sara Lopez: can we talk about price expectations? Bridgepoint partners often push for referral commissions vs co-sell model. some of our accounts will want Redwood pricing ranges to adjudicate whether to do co-sell.
01:55 - Maya Chen: totally. high-level - hosted API is usage-based, dedicated/reserved is commit-based. for co-sell pilots we typically provide a partner discounted pilot pricing and then standard list or reserved commit if they want scale. i can send a ranges doc but we'll need to align on who owns the commercial conversation per account.
02:12 - Tom Grady: for OmniRetail, Bridgepoint can own the initial commercial if Redwood provides partner pricing guidance. if the pilot shows strong unit economics we can move to a committed reserved model.
02:23 - Ethan Brooks: technical note - OmniRetail mentioned latency requirements for embedding lookup under 50ms p50. depending on model size and quantization we'll need to size the instance type; dedicated GPU pools with batching and KV cache tuning will help.
02:36 - Amir Patel: is that something you can benchmark? our customer will want a performance number against their query volumes.
02:40 - Ethan Brooks: yes we can run a benchmark. for accurate numbers we'll need a small trace of their typical sequence lengths and qps. if Bridgepoint can request an anonymized sample payload that'd be ideal.
02:52 - Sara Lopez: will do. second deal is 'FinServeX' - large financial SaaS, highly regulated, they're asking about data residency in eu only and strong KMS controls. timeline is longer, maybe Q3.
03:05 - Maya Chen: sounds reasonable. for EU residency we have region routing and private options; we also offer customer-managed KMS. we will need to coordinate our legal/compliance teams for an MSA addendum. can Bridgepoint intro to their procurement contact?
03:18 - Tom Grady: yes. we'll do an intro. question from our side: what's Redwood's usual SLA and SLAs for dedicated pools - uptime, latency?
03:28 - Ethan Brooks: for Redwood Dedicated we have SLA-backed uptime at the pool level; typical latency depends on model and GPU. we'll share per-model performance profiles. Our console provides token-level cost/latency breakdowns which customers like.
03:40 - Sara Lopez: anytime we talk to their procurement they ask about audit logs and RBAC for multi-tenant scenarios. do you have a short doc?
03:47 - Maya Chen: yes, security brief will include RBAC, audit logs, retention configs, and integrations with SSO/SAML. Ethan can add a note about tenant isolation for dedicated pools.
03:57 - Amir Patel: third opp is 'HealthPoint' - smaller hospital network evaluated LLM summarization for discharge notes. they are sticklers about PHI and need BAA. does Redwood support BAAs?
04:08 - Maya Chen: we do support BAA for enterprise private deployments - need to engage legal, but we've done BAAs with other healthcare customers. i'll surface previous example requests and steps.
04:18 - Tom Grady: great. so overall three opportunities with different risk profiles.
04:24 - Ethan Brooks: one more technical caution - on sequence lengths for HealthPoint we will want to advise on model choice and quantization; longer context windows increase memory and latency costs. for summarization often a smaller fine-tuned model with prompt engineering is more cost-effective.
04:39 - Sara Lopez: good call. question - Bridgepoint would like to run a joint webinar/demo for a couple of accounts, is Redwood open to co-hosting?
04:47 - Maya Chen: absolutely, we do co-host webinars and customer days. we'll need to line up slides, decide on who presents which part - marketing collateral can be shared after this call.
04:56 - Tom Grady: about the joint pipeline tracker, do you have a preferred format? our ops team uses a spreadsheet with stages and close plan.
05:03 - Maya Chen: we have a partner pipeline template we can share - i'll put it in the follow-up email with ownership columns and recommended cadence.
05:10 - Amir Patel: on demos: can you whitelist Bridgepoint engineering IPs for demo access? sometimes the secure demo portal blocks partner IPs.
05:19 - Ethan Brooks: yes, we can whitelist. i'll include the steps and required IP ranges in the tech checklist.
05:25 - Sara Lopez: any competitor mentions to watch out for in these accounts? OmniRetail might be talking to Cohere and OpenAI for embeddings, FinServeX asked about vector DB vendors like Pinecone.
05:36 - Maya Chen: noted - our angle is better production economics and unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private; for vector DBs we often integrate with existing vendors but can also recommend caching strategies to reduce calls and cost.
05:48 - Tom Grady: timeline recap - OmniRetail Q2 pilot, FinServeX Q3, HealthPoint exploratory in Q2 but procurement will slow it.
05:58 - Maya Chen: ok next steps recap - I'll send co-sell one-pager, pipeline template, SOC2 and security brief. Ethan will send the tech checklist and demo whitelisting steps. Bridgepoint will confirm anonymized payload sample for OmniRetail and identify the three priority accounts officially.
06:15 - Sara Lopez: sounds good. we'll try to have the sample and priority list to you by next week.
06:20 - Amir Patel: quick note - when you send the tech checklist, please clarify what we need for an on-prem vs VPC POC so we can budget time with their infra teams.
06:31 - Ethan Brooks: will do. i'll add a short 'on-prem vs VPC' section with estimated lead times.
06:36 - Maya Chen: any other blockers?
06:38 - Tom Grady: not from my side.
06:40 - Sara Lopez: no, thanks all.
06:42 - Maya Chen: great thanks everyone, i'll follow up with the docs and action items. we'll target a short sync in two weeks to check status.
06:50 - (call ends)

Notes on transcript quality: some speaker labels may be approximate, occasional mis-transcription of product names (eg 'Red wood' or 'K V cache' instead of KV cache). References to shared artifacts: co-sell one-pager (link to be shared), partner pipeline spreadsheet (will be attached), SOC2 and security brief (will be attached).
